Step 8: Edits persist.

custom_steps:
1. Log in as the test user.
2. Top nav > 'Work Orders'.
3. Click the create-new-WO button.
4. Fill in required fields (customer, asset).
5. Save the new WO.
6. Open the saved WO.
7. Edit the status field, the lead technician, the service advisor.
8. Save.
9. Look for any delete affordance.
title: Work Orders Create and Edit enables creating and modifying WOs
